messages:
Maya: opened PR #4839 to update the 'stellaris7b' model card: bump max_context 8192 -> 12288, add fresh bench table, and replace old SDK snippets. please eyeball samples and compatibility callouts.
Sam: Link? I can review later today.
Maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4839 — includes p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec per GPU with batching=auto, and a new section about warm vs cold start behavior.
Elaine: Quick scan: bench numbers look fine but the embeddings throughput cell still shows the legacy sharded number (4k qps at 8k seq). might be the old harness tag.
Maya: You're right, that slipped in. I re-ran bench with tag 'stellaris-v2' and updated table. Excerpt: 
```
# bench summary (stellaris-v2)
p50: 18ms
p95: 120ms
p99: 320ms
throughput: 720 tokens/s per GPU (batching=auto)
```
Sam: Can you paste the SDK examples you added? I want to ensure we use SDK v3 async + streaming idioms instead of v2 sync.
Maya: Original PR had sync-only v2 examples. I replaced them with: Python sync (v3), Python async streaming, and TypeScript promise + streaming sample.
Tim: Also add a compatibility note: 4-bit quantized variants are supported only on Dedicated and Private. Add explicit line about CPU fallback and edge runtimes not supporting these quantized stellaris variants.
Nina: Bench artifact link in the draft returned 404 for me. Correct link is https://bench.redwood/reports/stellaris-v2 — please update references.
docs-bot: CI lint error: markdown anchor 'limits' not present. Suggested anchor 'capacity-limits'.
Maya: I pushed a follow-up commit fixing anchors and swapping the bench links.
Sam: Ping me when that's pushed; I'll review the TS snippet and async stream API shape.
Elaine: Suggest adding a short migration paragraph for stellaris6b -> stellaris7b highlighting token trimming behavior and recommended prompt strategy for long-context. Example prompt-set would help.
Maya: Added a 3-sentence migration blurb and a prompt-truncation snippet under docs/examples/stellaris/long-context.md in the PR. Also clarified the throughput caption to state tokens/sec/GPU with batching=auto. PTAL @Sam @Elaine.
Sam: Reviewing now. If the streaming example matches the SDK streaming callbacks it's good to merge.
Elaine: LGTM on the migration blurb. One nit: rephrase 'throughput' row to 'tokens/sec per GPU (batching=auto)'.
Maya: Updated wording, added CHANGELOG entry noting limits bump and quant compatibility. Will merge once CI passes.
Tim: +1. :thumbsup:
